summary: This Form 6-K filed by StoneCo Ltd. reports only the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, an ordinary routine meeting. The resolutions include ratification of financial statements, reelection of existing directors, and election of two new directors. No M&A, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC activity is described. The filing is a standard post-meeting disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation event.
